articles.원문 요약: The loading of fuel assemblies into the core of unit 2 at the San'ao nuclear power plant in China's Zhejiang province has been completed ahead of its start up. The unit is the second of six HPR1000s (Hualong Ones) planned at the site.

articles.원문 요약: A 12-tonne double beam box, which is set to double the UK's flagship fusion machine's plasma conditions to 60 million degrees Celsius, has been moved into position.
